system_ram_type-*-value.basis: UI adds RAM/SDRAM to the same stated DDR generation. LPDDR variants and form factors are deliberately excluded.

cpu_model-*-family-*-value.basis: Exact branded CPU family names; CPU model number and identity consistency remain separately checked. No model/generation/AI-family substitution.

wireless_comm_standard-*-value.basis: Same explicit IEEE standard. Amazon's observed 802.11be display label contains an extra dot; its original code is preserved. This does not establish radio installation or bands.

graphics_card_interface-*-value.basis: PCIe/PCI-E are the abbreviation of PCI Express; no lane count, version or dedicated-GPU inference.

voltage-*-unit.basis: Exact unit abbreviations; generic V never supplies AC/DC scope.

battery-*-cell_composition-*-value.basis: Equivalent chemistry spelling only; lithium metal is separate. Battery form/size and installation declarations are not inferred.

lithium_battery-*-energy_content-*-unit.basis: Wh means watt hours; never interchangeable with Ah/mAh, watts or kWh without an evidenced conversion.

lithium_battery-*-packaging-*-value.basis: The current template Definition explicitly maps in equipment, with equipment and only to these three packaging meanings. It does not verify a product's actual pack-out.

audio_connector_input_output-*-function.basis: For this audio-jack functionality field, these explicit descriptions say headphone output plus microphone input. No connector diameter, pole count or electrical standard is inferred.
